feature_history_review.conclusion: Source provides fields and code paths for carrying repair age/blocked state through migration. The receipts establish complete census flags and global count/debt conservation, but omit migrated cell rows and queue identities, so exact per-feature age/rejection preservation in this migration is not independently verifiable from these aggregates. This limitation also applies to the second late migration at c8/c9.
feature_history_review.source_contract: repair_queue is ordered by (repair_epoch, RepairFeature), and selection starts with begin() as oldest. CachedRow stores 14 repair epochs and active/blocked bitmasks. SaveRepairState serializes the per-cell state; RestoreRepairState rebuilds repair demands and queue. last_rejected_feature is a single latest-value diagnostic, not a time series.
